name: Webhook
description: POST the notice as JSON to a URL. Works with Feishu, Slack, Discord, ntfy and anything else that takes a webhook.

url.title: Where to POST
url.description: A webhook URL is a credential: whoever holds it can speak as the user in that channel, and whoever changes it decides where the user's notices go instead. So give a reference -- env:, file: or keychain: -- to somewhere it has already been put. Editing this file by hand, a plain URL and cmd: both still work; it is the tool surface that will not write either.
